description: Chooses a nibble of a row byte according to a frame counter modulo three, then scans up to 36 entries of a table in the global block for the matching value. It stores the matched entry in the A5 state block, or the frame word when the nibble is the high one.

name: copy_word_to_state_slot

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13C94
name: select_table_step_and_direction
description: Finds the first entry of a table of 37 word values that does not exceed the frame's current value, adjusts it when a flag bit is set, and stores it as the target. It also records in the frame whether the target lies below the current value.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13CF4
name: ramp_value_toward_target
description: Stores a new step size from the frame byte when it is non-zero, then moves a current value toward its target by that step, clamping at the target. When the frame's effect nibble is set it looks up the matching table entry and stores the result.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13D84
name: compute_oscillator_offset
description: Updates a depth and speed setting from the frame byte, then computes a periodic offset from a waveform table, a sawtooth or a constant, scaled by depth. It adds the offset to the base value in the frame, stores the result in the A5 state block and advances the phase.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13DD6
name: apply_oscillator_offset_scaled
description: Applies a depth-scaled offset built from the argument byte, negating it when the phase is negative, then adds it to the base value in the frame and advances the phase.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13DE4
name: apply_oscillator_offset_plain
description: Adds a depth-scaled offset built from the argument byte to the base value in the frame, then advances the phase.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13DE8
name: apply_table_offset_to_base
description: Reads a byte from a table at the address register plus an index, scales it by the depth setting, adds it to the base value in the frame, and advances the phase.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13E06
name: store_difference_and_advance_phase

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13F14
name: adjust_channel_volume
description: Stores the base value into the A5 state block, then adjusts a volume field held in the frame by the high or low nibble of a parameter byte. The result is clamped between zero and sixty-four and to a global limit, and stored.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:13FFA
name: dispatch_tracker_effect_command
description: Interprets one effect command nibble from a tracker row and branches on it to set volume, speed, pattern jumps, pattern breaks or per-channel values, returning a value for the caller. The listing is truncated, so the later branches are not recovered.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:140F2
name: store_low_nibble_in_frame
description: Stores the low nibble of a frame byte into another frame byte. The decompiled body shows only this store although the listing covers 108 instructions, so the rest is not recovered, and the DMA control writes listed in the facts do not appear in the pseudo-code.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:1427C
name: advance_and_invert_buffer_byte
description: Adds a rate taken from a table to a frame accumulator when a nibble is set. When the accumulator crosses the sign bit it resets it, advances a pointer through a buffer with wraparound, and bitwise inverts the byte at the new position.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:14822
name: copy_six_word_blocks
description: Walks a table of six entries, each giving a source address, a destination address and a length, and copies words from source to destination for each one. It returns the D0 argument with the constant 249 ORed in.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:20F02
name: write_dma_setup_words
description: Writes an all-ones word, two zero words, the address argument, another zero word and a count of 8 to hardware-related globals in sequence. The DMA control register is listed in the facts, but the listing shows only these stores.

key: Bill's Tomato Game (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr SKR][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$2C00 to $040000 (161792 bytes):0:20F74
name: dispatch_byte_command_sequence
description: Counts down a timer and, when it fires or on immediate entry, reads bytes from a pointer one at a time and calls the handler selected by each byte through a jump table. The loop shows no explicit end test, so the stop condition is not recovered.
